difficulty_reason: The general constant-k statement requires a new reverse transformation from a multiparty common-zero protocol to a constant-free threshold circuit, not merely the familiar circuit-to-protocol descent. Its complete author core builds a hypotheses-game strategy by refining bounded communication profiles while maintaining h-low completeness, then converts the strategy's light form into the circuit. This universal construction is a separate structural proof obligation from the paper's explicit majority formula and exceeds a routine parameter or gate-basis restatement.
